notes.title: Version 20+ Notes - More features. More fixes. More cat shenanigans.
notes.notes:
[b]Version 20+ adds even more features and refinements to the ver. 20 release![/b]

[b]There are now options to change the player character voice from the Player Setup or Audio menu:[/b]
[list]
[*]Cute & Wild (MeowMeow's chatty default.)
[*]Shy Kitten (MeowMeow's quiet version, no midlevel voicelines or combat taunts.)
[*]Rough & Tough (MeowMeow does a tough fps guy impression, also no midlevel voicelines or combat taunts.)
[*]The player character has varying jump sounds now as well, in case it got too repetitive.
[/list]

[b]The Lighter is replaced by throwable Flares![/b]
[list]
[*]You can throw up to 4 flares at the same time.
[*]One flare lasts 10 seconds.
[*]You can even distract or lure enemies a bit with them! Neat!
[/list]

[b]The secret Nekobots have more features to them as well:[/b]
[list]
[*]Nekobots are now summoned by throwing around delicious taiyaki pastries instead of bloody gibs. (Why were they gibs in the first place???)
[*]How to summon them? Call out to them in their own language. A lot.
[*]Player can now pet the Nekobots with the Meow button, it gives 1-2 health! Cat therapy. A critical feature.
[*]Not only do the Nekobots provide moral support, they also now go after enemies! They don't do much damage, but can serve as support in a pinch.
[/list]
	
[b]There are now 3 types of door keys with themes that match better to the levels they're in:[/b]
[list]
[*]Keycards
[*]Demon Keys (new!)
[*]Pyramid Keys
[/list]

[b]Level balancing & fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Episode 1's level 2 got more difficulty balancing as it was a pretty mean step up from the first level. Should be more manageable now!
[*]Episode 1's level 3 has better pacing with the monster spawns and progression. All three keys are used now.
[*]Episode 2's level 1 got a new secret, the magnum pillar with magnum power is no longer a secret and can be accessed more easily.
[*]More intermission camera spots added to episode 4's level 4.
[/list]

[b]The extra lives system:[/b]
[list]
[*]The game now defaults to using lives in single player games - We felt that just respawning from autosaves or manual saves broke the game's pacing a lot, so we're giving this a try. 
[*]It's easier to quickly jump back into action now.
[*]By default, if the player character dies, they respawn to an earlier point with most of their equipment, but the level status remains the same. Lose all lives in a level and the level starts from the beginning.
[*]The system allows adjusting it to use various amounts of lives, lives earned with score, a 9-lives challenge mode, or to just use autosaves with the rules from earlier versions.
[*]It also allows the music tracks to not restart every time upon deaths and eliminates possible slowdowns caused by autosaves.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 20 Notes - Beauty Nap for MeowMeow and Music
notes.notes:
Version 20 has a [b]new cuter look[/b] for the player character [i](meow :3)[/i] and she can now appear with or without her helmet! First person animations also got interpolation, so they should be a lot smoother now. There are also new animations for throwing bombs and clawing things.

There is one more complete level: [b]E4L4: Meows From The Deep[/b] that takes place in an underwater base with a geothermal power plant in the basement. There are some little tweaks on couple other levels too.

Menus got some reorganizing and 2 player splitscreen games can be split vertically (new default). If you're playing a 2 player game and you've got 2 displays, you can play the game in a window that is stretched to both displays! HUD elements can now be turned on/off individually and a toggle for the whole hud (for taking some hudless screenshots).

[b]MeowGun[/b] also got a... [i]<drum-roll>[/i] psychedelic/acid/techno/trance [b]SoundTrack![/b] There are total 14 tracks for levels and 2 for intermission & title screen. Made some new ones and remastered a bunch of my old tracks for use in the game. There is also a Jukebox in the game if you just want to listen to them or change a track while playing a level.

Note: loading a saved game will restart the assigned level track, also loading a save from an older version may require a level restart or using the Jukebox to have music play in the level.

Here's the full changelog:
[b]LEVELS:[/b]
[list]
[*]E4L4:
	The level is complete!
[*]E4L3:
	Fixed a floating arrow light at the large freight elevator
[*]E1L1:
	A little update on the blue key location
[*]E2L1:
	Added a little pedestal for the magnum pistol, so it's easier to spot it (maybe more improvements later)
[*]E2S1:
	Fixed the 4 buttons, so you can't press the same button 4 times to activate the secret
[/list]
[b]MUSIC:[/b]
[list]
[*]There's music in the game now!
	Total 14 tracks for levels!
	2 for intermission/title screen!
[/list]
[b]PLAYER:[/b]
[list]
[*]The player character has an improved cuter look, meow :3
[*]First person animations are now interpolated
[*]New animations for throwing Bombs and attacking with the Cat Claws
[*]Horizontal movement is slowed a little when climbing up a wall, so it's easier to climb onto some narrow ledges
[/list]
[b]WEAPONS:[/b]
[list]
[*]There are weapon/bomb selection sounds
	Some may be a bit placeholder and improved/replaced later
[*]Lightning Ripper:
	It doesn't switch permanently to the melee mode when hitting enemies
	Melee mode can be activated by sawing a wall
[*]Hand Cannons:
	Primary fire is the cannon ball that was previously the alternate fire, still uses 2 shells
	Alternate fire shoots multiple cannon balls, uses 4 shells
	Less self damage than before
[*]Grenade Launcher:

[/list]
[b]MENU:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a Jukebox menu to the main menu
[*]Removed Help menu, did anyone even read it...
	Though there's a little easter egg thingy with F1, or gamepad Select when in the menu

	They're still in the Settings menu

[*]Player Setup menu now has color and name settings for all 4 players that can be used in splitscreen games
[*]Added End Game possibility to the Game and Multiplayer menus
	You can return to the intro/title screen without needing to use the console
[*]Added some skill descriptions when starting a new game

[*]Default Max FPS is now 250
[*]There's been some changes to sound effect volumes, they're a little quieter and the default volume is increased to 0.5
[*]Added a music volume slider, default 0.5

notes.title: Version 19 Notes - Performance boost and a fancy big pile of secrets
notes.notes:
Version 19 introduces 3 more fully completed levels: 
Episode 3 Secret: Alien Dimension with MeowMeow wreaking havoc at the alien homeworld.
Episode 4 Level 1: Castlemania with spooky atmosphere and silly references.
Episode 4 Secret: G8 To It with a stupid amount of monsters, big weapons and varying biomes.

If you can't find the secret level entrances, they are selectable from the Story Mode menu for quick access.

There's also a major improvement to the game performance overall, so there should be way less stutter and no little freezes every now and then. Using autosaves might still cause tiny slowdowns. Gamepad support is better in menus and during gameplay. Menus also got some cleanup and polish. Intro screen got nice fade ins to the visuals and audio. Looks classier overall.

Earlier the game defaulted to Borderless Windowed, but this was causing some stutter, so if you want smoother performance, be sure to use Fullscreen video mode.

Here's the full changelog:

[list]
[*]E3S1:
	The level is now fully complete
	There's a big new area in the beginning of the level!
[*]E4L1
	The level is now fully complete
	A whole lot more areas!
[*]E4S1
	The level is now fully complete
	There's one more big area to explore!
[*]E1L3:
	The rotating thingies have their vertices snapped to grid
	There's a button in the sewer next to the assault rifle
	There's some blue decorative lights near the stairs and teleport at the top side
[/list]
[b]PLAYER & WEAPONS:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some dumb issue with diagonal movement with the gamepad
	So playing on the gamepad doesn't feel like being a little drunk
[*]Hitscan weapons that displayed explosion models no longer spawn an explosion mid-air close to player if gibbing an enemy
[*]Added particle effects to Plasma Grenades and Mega Cannon Plasma
[*]Grenade Launcher & Black Bombs:
	The clusters explode in mid-air after a very short duration
[*]Railgun:
	Uses only 5 ammo per shot
	No damage reduction when it pierces enemies
[*]Plasma Grenade:
	They now have a little shock blast effect
	Only 4 smart plasma balls
[/list]
[b]POWERUPS, MONSTERS & MISC:[/b]
[list]
[*]Catnomicon Combat gives a 20% damage boost, earlier was 25%
[*]Added a wall candle object
[*]Some adjustments to how kill enough monsters counter triggers work on Nightfeline and Mäyhemicus Catus
[/list]
[b]MENU, MEOWPEDIA & HELP:[/b]

[*]Cleanup on the menus!
[*]Using the menu with a gamepad have more standard controls
[*]There are helper graphics for using the menu at the bottom

	Reading/writing to text files during gameplay caused occassional freezes and other minor fps drops
[/list]

	They were named incorrectly, should have been the other way

notes.title: Version 18 Notes - Spring cleaning + A new episode structure
notes.notes:
Version 18 splits the levels into 4 episodes! There's an episode selection hub level. Player returns to it after completing each episode. The story mode levels got some adjustments to accommodate the new episode structure. There's also an optional tutorial level for new players.

Weapons and monsters got some tweaks too. The Vampire Sword got a big overhaul with a new model, animations and gameplay mechanics! The HUD got some little bits of clarification as well.

Due to popular demand, there's also a shareware/demo version coming shortly! Just need to figure out adding it to Steam. The shareware version includes the first episode, which is 5 + 1 story mode levels, 1 dm/survival and the tutorial and episode selection levels. It should have lots to try out!

notes.title: Version 17 Notes - The Memey Levels Update
notes.notes:
Version 17 adds 2 new levels: Level 17: Oil and Brimstone and Level 18: Inari Lake Base. There are some little balancing adjustments to some Episode 1 levels too.

Player can now throw the bombs faster with a quick key/button without having to select the bombs like other weapons. Also player can Zoom in and out. Watch out, falling damage is increased when falling from really high places!

Note: The new gameplay features may need you to remap keys/buttons if you have something mapped into their default keys/buttons. So check the settings before playing!

Here's the full changelog:

[b]LEVELS:[/b]
[list]
[*]Level 18:
	The level is now fully complete!
[*]Level 17:
	The level is now fully complete!
	Might extend it a bit later, but for now it's big enough!
[*]Level 01:
	Added a tutorial message about the new bomb throwing functionality, alternate fire modes and power meows
[*]Level 02:
	Added a tutorial message about the new zoom function
[*]Level 03:
	Added one more intermission spot
[*]Levels 04:
	Adjusted some weapon, ammo and monster teleport trigger placements
[*]Levels 05 - 06:
	Adjusted some weapon placements
[*]Level 09:
	Added a little block in one secret to allow backtracking to regular playarea
[*]It is now possible to change the intermission view location with the Alternate Fire Button
	The view also changes automatically every 5 seconds
[/list]

[b]PLAYER & WEAPONS:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased falling damage, so watch out when deciding to jump from really high places!
	Catnomicon Sport still drops the 10 and below damage and halves the rest of the falling damage
[*]Max Bullets dropped to 320
[*]Max Cells dropped to 240
[*]Max Fuel dropped to 160
[*]It's possible to Zoom in / out with a button, Default Mouse3 and gamepad Right Thumbstick press
	Check the settings in case you've mapped something else there
[*]Throwable bombs can be thrown quickly without having to select them like other weapons
	Note: they no longer have alternate fire modes
	Throw: G or gamepad Right Bumper
	Select: 6 or gamepad X	
	Check the settings in case you've mapped something else there
[*]Grenade Launcher:
	Grenades have slightly bigger explosion radius,
	little bit more splash damage and little less impact damage
[*]SMG:
	Minirockets have slightly bigger explosion radius
[/list]

[b]HAZARDS & POWERUPS:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed explosive barrels and boxes to be able to damage each other and trigger chain explosions
	Oopsie!
[*]Catnomicon Armor and Treatment only regenerate up to 200 even with Magnum Power or Lightning Shield
	Also the regeneration rate is slowed down to 5 seconds from 4 seconds
[*]Catnomicon Combat is now named Book of Hiss
[*]Catnomicon Sport is now named Book of Boop
[/list]

[b]SETTINGS & CHEATS:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added OpenAL enable/disable setting into the Audio menu (in case sounds start to repeat when it's enabled)
	New default is OpenAL disabled
[*]Added an option to enable/disable Tutorial Messsages (in level 01) into the Player Setup menu

	Note: there's no messages when turning them on, 249 gives them all
	and the cheats don't take them away if entered again
[/list]

notes.title: Version 16 Notes
notes.notes:
Version 16 returns the automatic melee when at close range to enemies back to the Magnum Pistol primary fire. There was a Yield CPU setting that was automatically turned on, on all systems. Thought it only turned on automatically on laptops. Well, now it's turned off completely as it decreased framerate kind of unnecessarily. Now just use the Max FPS setting to set a lower framerate if necessary. The Max FPS setting also has a list of preset numbers, so it's easier to use, but you can still manually type if you want.

Here's the full changelog:

[b]Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*]Level 01:
	Added a message about using the Lighter just when going to the dark tunnels
[/list]

[b]Weapons:[/b]
[list]
[*]Magnum Pistol & Cat Claws:
	Returned the automatic melee back to the primary fire
	The automatic melee does basic punches only
	Alternate fire can still do the double punches
	Killing enemies with the Cat Claw melee attacks restore the Power Meow faster
[/list]

[b]Settings:[/b]
[list]
[*]Max FPS setting has a preset list to make it easier to set the Max FPS
	But it's still possible to type a custom FPS limit
[*]Removed Yield CPU setting and also forcing it off (just adjust the max fps if you need lower max fps)
[/list]

[b]Easter Eggs:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Nekobots spawn more into random directions and no longer spawn stuck to each other
[/list]

notes.title: Version 14 Notes
notes.notes:
Version 14 adds a new smoother particle set and fireballs, screenshakes for weapons, voicelines for level starts (non wip levels). There's a new model for the Mega Cannon and improvements to the Fusionblaster texture. The Plasmagun smart plasma became the Mega Cannon primary fire, and the Mega Cannon beam became the Plasmagun alternate fire.

The records menu now has page numbers and there's total statistics for playing through all levels as well some random player statistics. Note: the new level records are recorded to one file per level, which also means previous level records are gone, as they were recorded to multiple files per level (one for each skill). The Settings menu also has a Reset Records functionality in case you want to reset them.

Had to revert the earlier 16 sound channel system back to the engine default as it seemed to cause some lagging in online multiplayer. It is possible some areas with lots of monsters may sound louder now.

If loading a save game made with an earlier version, you may need to Restart the level.

notes.title: Version 12 Notes

Version 12 is a mini update with couple little fixes and tweaks on the weapons. It also returns the weapon hit stats back to view in the Records menu. New voice lines for the new weapons that were added in version 11.

notes.title: Version 11 Notes
notes.notes:
Version 11 adds lots of new weapons including submachineguns, the fusion blaster and throwable bombs. Previously existing weapons got plenty of polish and tweaks as well. There are also big and small ammo items for each ammo type. Regarding monsters, a new faster nightmare fiend and a tougher horned demon are introduced. Work in progress versions of Level 20 and Secret 02 are included as playground levels to test the new weapons. Have fun!

	The amount of Dimensional Shambler's homing projectiles

[b]Player:[/b]
[list]

	Shells: 80
	Rockets: 40

[b]Weapons:[/b]

[*]Plenty of polish on various weapon models/textures

notes.title: Version 7 Notes
notes.notes:
Version 7 includes yet another new level, new monsters or variations, new alternate firing modes and player can do a Power Meow. Player and level stats can be recorded to the Records menu, which also contains background stories for the weapons, monsters and levels.

Here's a long detailed list of the changes:

[b]Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*]Levels 01 - 04 and Secret 99:
	Returned the Energy Cells for the Lightning Ripper
[*]Levels 05 - 10, Secret 01 and DM 01 - 03:
	There are some Fusion Missiles (Level 08 doesn't have any)
[*]Level 06:
	The fence at the top and center of the level can be climbed
	and added some block to make it easier to get over the fence
[*]Level 12:
	New Level!
[/list]

[b]Monsters:[/b]
[list]
[*]Alien Watchdog:
	New Enemy, starts appearing in Episode 2
	Fires flame grenades and can make leaping attacks
[*]Alien Acidbug:
	New Enemy, starts appearing in Episode 2
	Flying, charges toward and explodes
[*]Alien Berserker:
	Variation of the Alien Hunter, starts appearing Episode 2
	Melee only, high damage resistance
[*]Alien Rocketeer:
	Variation of the Alien Hunter, starts appearing Episode 2
	Can alternte between flight and walk, fires volleys of rockets
[*]The new monsters may also appear in Survival mode
[*]Fixed monsters spawners not getting removed when dying in singleplayer Survival
[*]Monster eyes glow much less when they're dead (may still appear bright in bright light)
[*]Resurrected monsters are not counted to kills/total monsters in intermission level stats
	Unless playing on Nightmare skill or Survival mode
[/list]

[b]Player:[/b]
[list]
[*]Decreased wall climb/jump height to 91 units
[*]Some changes in air control & friction
[*]Clear Catnomicons from HUD when respawning
[*]Player can now do a Power Meow, default key: R or gamepad GP_Y (the default bindings don't override anything already bound to these keys/buttons)
	The power meow does some damage, throws the enemies around and gives them a little bit of stun effect
	Cooldown 30s until can do another
[*]If using autoaim, the autoaim aims about in the vertical center of the target
[/list]

[b]Weapons:[/b]
[list]
[*]Magnum Pistol:
	Primary: Magnum Bullet
	Alternate: Explosive Magnum Flare, use 2 ammo per shot
	The weak unlimited bullets are only used if have 0 magnum bullets
[*]Lightning Ripper:
	Reverted back to using Energy Cells as ammo
	Primary: Single Lightning Bolt, can chain into 1 extra target, use 2 ammo
	Alternate: Ball Lightning, can slide along surface, shoots lightning bolts at nearby targets, use 10 ammo
	The blade is automatically used in melee range if using the primary attack or if have no ammo
[*]Machinegun:
	Fixed muzzleflash being displayed if ran out of bullets and keep the fire button down
	that was a side effect from trying to make the barrels spin a little longer after stopping firing
	Also fixed the weapon not switching to another weapon if ran out of bullets and kept the fire button down
	Alternate: Mini Rockets, fires a 2x mini rockets, one minirocket use 5 ammo
[*]Railgun:
	Fixed incorrect message about not having Magnum Bullets when have 0 Shells and try to change to Railgun
	Dropped Railguns now give Shells instead of Magnum Bullets
[*]Grenade Launcher:
	Impact grenades are launched with a slightly higher velocity
[*]Rocket Launcher -> Missile Launcher:
	Can fire 3 kinds of Missiles
	Primary: Guided Missiles
	Alternate: Incendiary Missiles, can be found from rocket boxes, max capacity 12, use 2 ammo per shot
	Alternate: Fusion Missiles, rare, max capacity 4, use 4 ammo per shot (the Fusion Missiles replace the Incendiary Missiles when found)
[*]Flamethrower:
	Does a bit more damage on the first few frames
	Flame trail lose velocity a bit faster and use the explosion model
[*]Plasmagun:
	Smart Plasma does radius damage while flying
	Smart Plasma does more damage
	Smart Plasma lasts a little longer
[*]Flame Grenades/Bombs:
	They only spawn one dynamic light that lasts longer instead of multiple shorter lasting ones
	They spawn some smoke particles when the flame has burned out
[*]Fixed Magnum Bullet and Railgun trails to show correctly when fired in any direction
[*]Alternate attacks use 1.5x main ammo if using the gameplay setting where alternate fire ammos are not needed

[*]Fixed incorrect total monster count on Extreme skill in Level 10
[*]Respawning hazards that target trigger_counter behave similar to respawning monsters
[*]Level exit makes the teleport sound

[list]
[*]Total 3000 monsters on Hard and 50 secrets

[*]Level 02 has more moving platforms at the end
[*]Level 03 has the starting area extended and wider sewer corridors
[*]Level 04 has the ending area extended
[*]Level 05 got some cover blocks to the water area
[*]Level 06 has the red key teleporter two way
[*]Level 08 has the two areas extended
[*]Level 09 has some cover blocks in the area after the blue key
[*]Secret 99 has the spikeroom exterior extended and the quicksand changed to water
[/list]

[b]Player:[/b]
[list]
[*]Simplified armor to just 3 types: 33% Light, 50% Combat and 66% Mega
[*]Player can no longer jump over enemies to safety
[*]Player can jump/climb up walls a little higher than before (need to look at the wall to get up)
[*]Player's ammo capacity has been increased, no longer need backpacks to increase ammo capacity
[/list]

[b]Weapons:[/b]
[list]
[*]Ripper now has a limited supply of Chain Lightning attacks up to 9, recharges slowly up to 3 and can be used underwater
[*]You get Double Magnums from finding another pistol instead of the powerup
[*]Railgun now shoots multiple pellets that can pierce enemies and blast them into walls and uses Shells for ammo
[*]Machinegun only has one fire mode: full automatic at 1200rpm
[*]Grenade Launcher shoots incendiary grenades
[*]Rocket Launcher primary mode is dumb rockets and alternate fire is guided if you have some guided missiles
[*]Flamethrower is more devastating and has less ammo
[*]Plasmagun alternate fire no longer automatically homes into targets, you need to guide it yourself
[*]The Sword that appeared as reward in Secret 99 got removed and replaced with 3x Soul Crystals
[/list]

[b]Powerups:[/b]
[list]
[*]Power Ammo now gives 30s of Double Damage
[*]Magnum Power turbo shots, Lightning Shield strikes and Protective Suit degrade over time even when not actively used
[*]Lightning Shield can be used underwater
[*]Invisibility works underwater, the circuits have been waterproofed
[*]Catnomicons now give Combat, Armor, Treatment and Sporty powerups for the duration of the level
[*]New powerup: Soul Crystal, permanently increases max health by 1, total 17 in episode 1
[*]Backpacks are left into the level for later, if player can't pick up all the ammo from them
[/list]

[b]New sounds:[/b]
[list]
[*]Flying Maggots
[*]Fiends
[*]Demon Spawn
[/list]

[b]Other Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Possible to disable monsters from casting shadows, can speed up realtime lighting
[*]Crosshair can display target health status, default on
[*]Particle shape can be changed between: Textured, Circle and Sharp Square (textured is still just the rounded square)
[*]The ingame messages can be translated, currently there's: English, Finnish and R'lyehian translations
[*]The 256 color palette got greener greens and more saturated purples
[*]Fixed inaccuracy issues with hitscan enemies, they were shooting completely off target, now they have other kind of inaccuracy
[*]Ambush monsters notice player better
[/list]

notes.title: Version 2 Notes
notes.notes:
This update addresses some developer bindings that were forgotten in the default config and changes the default video mode to borderless windowed, which automatically uses your desktop resolution.

There are a bunch of other bug fixes and quality of life improvements, like autosave that actually works, and survival mode doesn't get saved to the config which earlier screwed up the storymode when loading a game.

You may want to use the Reset to Defaults from the Settings menu after updating, unless you already changed the video settings and/or key bindings.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]R no longer bound as Pause in default.cfg
[*]Default screenshot key changed to F11 to avoid taking 2x screenshots due to F12 being the default screenshot key on Steam
[*]Removed non xinput gamepad bindings from the default.cfg (the Gamepad Buttons menu should then only show GP_something bindings)
[*]Fov slider range is now 60 - 140 (higher / lower fovs can be set in the console like: fov 160)
[*]Default video mode is now Borderless Windowed (desktop resolution is automatically used)
[*]Fixed / cleaned up postproc_palette.glsl so the 256 color palette shader should also work on AMD cards

[*]Survival mode is now set with cvar "deathmatch 2", fixes gamemode incorrectly set as survival when playing storymode and loading a game
[*]Disabled engine default autosave "sv_autosave" and added autosave functionality with qc using "autosave_interval", defaults to 1 minute (setting not yet available in the menu, can be accessed from the console)
[*]Autosave also has a "autosave_safe" that allows checking if the current location / player condition is safe for the autosave, 0 disables, 1 has some safety (default), 2 has lots
[*]There's also 3 level start save slots (l0, l1 and l2)

[*]There's a weapon group info graphic displayed for a moment after pressing weapon change buttons, picking up weapons, displaying the level stats
[*]Key graphics in the hud are bigger and displayed underneath the score / top right corner (no longer displayed for every player in splitscreen as the keys are shared)

[*]Added a possibility to have individual weapon selection bindings
[*]Next/Previous Weapon order matches the Owned Weapons icons order
[*]Next/Previous Weapon no longer allows selecting the Ripper if player doesn't have the Ripper
[*]Fixed the Ripper still displaying Flash textures after having ran out of Cells
[*]Fixed player breath in sound after being underwater for a while

[*]Server browser now automatically updates the server list after 3 seconds
[*]Server browser no longer updates the server list when pressing up/down keys (bad idea if there ever were lots of servers online)
[*]Server browser can be manually updated by pressing R from keyboard or Select from gamepad

[*]All particle effects are done on the client to reduce packet sizes in online multiplayer
[*]Shotgun alternate firing mode fires the pellets in 2 sets to avoid datagram overflows in online multiplayer (may still happen sometimes, but not everytime)

[*]Added some more people to the Credits
[*]Included changelog with the install
[/list]
